name: ST NUCLEO-H743ZI2

source_references.title: ST STM32H7 Nucleo-144 boards (MB1364) user manual

record_note: NUCLEO-H743ZI2 is the MB1364 variant with STLINK-V3E. UM2407 gives an 8 MHz ST-LINK MCO as default HSE, a 25 MHz X3 crystal option (crystal not provided), and a 32.768 kHz X2 LSE default. ST-LINK firmware can change the MCO frequency. Board revision, solder bridges, pin reservations, and build/flash profiles remain open.
